_readme: Starter catalog. Every entry is UNVERIFIED (last_verified = null). Check each field against the official portal/PDF, then set last_verified to the date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave a field null if the official document does not state it. Add new schemes by copying an entry.

schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibility: Landholding farmer families

Not eligible: institutional landholders, holders of constitutional posts, serving/retired government officers (except MTS/Class IV/Group D), income tax payers, and registered professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs
schemes.income_limit: No income limit stated; income tax payers are excluded
schemes.benefits: Rs 6,000 per year in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000, paid directly to the bank account
application_process: Register on the official PM-KISAN portal (Farmers Corner) or through a Common Service Centre
Details are verified by the State government
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify against PM-KISAN operational guidelines)

schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.applicable_state: All India (states notify crops and areas)
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers
schemes.benefits: Insurance cover against crop loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases; farmers pay a low fixed premium (2% kharif, 1.5% rabi food crops and oilseeds, 5% commercial/horticultural crops)
application_process: Apply through your bank, a Common Service Centre, an insurance company agent or the official PMFBY portal before the cut-off date for the season
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify against current PMFBY guidelines)
schemes.deadline: Varies by crop season and state - check the portal

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
eligibility: Families identified through SECC 2011 deprivation and occupational criteria, plus categories added by states
No cap on family size or age
Senior citizens aged 70 and above are eligible regardless of income
schemes.income_limit: No income limit for the 70+ senior citizen category; other families are selected by deprivation criteria
schemes.benefits: Health cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals
application_process: Check eligibility on the official portal using mobile number or ration card details
Get an Ayushman card at an empanelled hospital, Ayushman Mitra desk or Common Service Centre
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify against PM-JAY guidelines)

schemes.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
eligibility: Urban families belonging to EWS, LIG or MIG segments
The family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
schemes.income_limit: Annual household income limits apply by segment (EWS/LIG/MIG) - confirm current limits on the official portal
schemes.benefits: Central assistance for house purchase, construction or enhancement as per the scheme component
application_process: Apply through the official PMAY-Urban portal or through the Urban Local Body / bank as directed
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify against current PMAY-U guidelines)

eligibility: Houseless families and families living in kutcha or dilapidated houses in rural areas, selected from the official beneficiary list (Awaas+/SECC)
schemes.income_limit: Selection is by housing deprivation criteria, not a single income limit
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance to build a pucca house (Rs 1.20 lakh in plains and Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas) plus related convergence support
application_process: Beneficiaries are identified through the Gram Sabha and the official list; contact your Gram Panchayat or Block office
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify against current PMAY-G guidelines)

schemes.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19 years or above
Women in regular government employment or covered by similar benefits under other laws are excluded
schemes.benefits: Cash incentive for the first living child and, under current rules, for a second child if a girl - confirm amounts and instalments on the official portal
application_process: Register through the nearest Anganwadi Centre / health facility or the official PMMVY portal
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify against current PMMVY guidelines)

schemes.scheme_name: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G), earlier MGNREGA
eligibility: Rural households whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work
Valid job card (existing e-KYC verified MGNREGA job cards remain valid until new cards are issued, per Ministry statement)
schemes.benefits: Guaranteed wage employment of up to 125 days per rural household per financial year under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025, which replaced MGNREGA from 1 July 2026
application_process: Apply for work through your Gram Panchayat using your job card
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry based on news reports of the Act's commencement (verify on the Ministry of Rural Development website)

schemes.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
eligibility: Artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in the traditional trades listed by the scheme
Minimum age 18 years
Not eligible: persons in government service
schemes.benefits: PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card, skill training with stipend, toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit support - confirm amounts on the official portal
application_process: Register at a Common Service Centre or on the official portal with Aadhaar-based authentication
Verification by the Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body and district committee
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify against PM Vishwakarma guidelines)

schemes.scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
schemes.department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
eligibility: Students who scored above the cut-off percentile in the Class 12 board examination and are pursuing regular college/university courses
schemes.income_limit: Family income limit applies - confirm the current limit on the National Scholarship Portal
schemes.benefits: Annual scholarship for graduation and post-graduation studies - confirm current amounts on the official portal
application_process: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal during the open window
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify on the National Scholarship Portal)

schemes.department: Government of India (hosted by the Ministry of Electronics and IT for several ministries)
eligibility: Eligibility differs for each scholarship listed on the portal - open the scheme's page for its criteria
schemes.benefits: Varies by scholarship scheme listed on the portal
application_process: Register on the portal, choose the scholarship you qualify for, and submit the online application

eligibility: Karnataka domicile students; eligibility differs for each pre-matric/post-matric scholarship on the portal
schemes.benefits: Varies by scholarship scheme on the portal
application_process: Create an account on the SSP portal and apply for the scholarship you qualify for

eligibility: Domicile students of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh seeking admission to eligible institutions outside the region - confirm details on the official portal
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (details not yet filled - add from the official document)

schemes.scheme_name: PM YASASVI (OBC, EBC and DNT scholarships)
schemes.department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
eligibility: Students belonging to OBC, EBC and DNT communities - confirm class-wise criteria on the official portal
schemes.income_limit: Family income limit applies - confirm the current limit on the official portal
schemes.benefits: Scholarships for school and higher education - confirm amounts on the official portal
application_process: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify on the National Scholarship Portal)

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY)
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
eligibility: Scheduled Caste communities; the scheme mainly funds area and institutional development (such as SC-majority villages and hostels) - confirm individual benefits in the official guidelines
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (details not yet filled - add from the official guidelines)

eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises needing business loans
schemes.benefits: Collateral-free loans in Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 lakh) and Tarun (Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh) categories, with a higher Tarun Plus category announced later - confirm on the official portal
required_documents: Business details as required by the lending institution
application_process: Apply at a bank, NBFC or microfinance institution, or through the official online loan portal
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify on the MUDRA website)

schemes.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (implemented by KVIC)
eligibility: Individuals aged 18 and above setting up a new micro enterprise
Education requirement applies for higher project costs - confirm on the official portal
schemes.benefits: Government subsidy on the project cost linked to a bank loan; subsidy rate depends on category and rural/urban location - confirm current rates
application_process: Apply online on the PMEGP e-portal; the application is processed through KVIC/KVIB/DIC and a bank
schemes.source_document: Starter catalog entry (verify on the PMEGP portal)
